## Summary

I implemented customerCode de-duplication in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline.

**`CustomerCodes.java`** — added a `deduplicate(String code, Collection<String> taken)` helper: returns the code unchanged when unused, otherwise appends `-<n>` with the smallest `n >= 2` producing a code not already in `taken` (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D-2`, then `-3`, …).

**`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — the `assignCustomerCode` step now injects `OwnerRepository` (by type, per the OfficeFloor convention), collects the customerCodes of all existing owners, and sets the built owner's code via `CustomerCodes.deduplicate(CustomerCodes.of(owner), taken)`. Since this step runs before `SaveOwner`, the new owner isn't yet persisted, so it never collides with itself, and the deduped code correctly flows into the downstream `AssignMembershipNumber` step (which derives `membershipNumber` from `customerCode`).

The `Cp41` acceptance test (`coreCustomerCodesStayUnique` — distinct owners always get distinct customerCodes) passes, as does the whole suite with no regressions.
